text: Clients one month, nothing the next?
spoken: Is your marketing built, or patched? One question tells you.
visual: Charcoal cloth on ivory paper; one gold gingham scrap torn half off, hanging by its sewn left edge; its empty stitch holes on the cloth

text: "Try a new channel." That's not the problem.
spoken: Your channel's fine. Each fix just started from zero.
visual: One big scrap sewn on the cloth with the label NEW CHANNEL, struck through in red

text: Tried everything? Each fix started from zero.
spoken: Your fixes each worked a while. Here's why none stuck.
visual: Three different scraps sewn apart on the cloth, labelled REFERRALS, COLD EMAIL, POSTING

text: Does each fix start from zero?
spoken: One question shows if your marketing will hold.
visual: Two scraps side by side on the cloth, FIX 1 gingham and FIX 2 dots, nothing shared
